nodes.label: Snapshot retip

nodes.label: Carry-over via hidden menu
nodes.rationale: Not automatic: reading on every right-click flashes on Wayland; More ends with FreeCAD's menu… instead.

nodes.label: FreeCAD four-layer menu
nodes.rationale: View provider actions, workbench items, fixed items, tree actions; follows workbench not object.

nodes.label: Everything else group
nodes.rationale: Nothing goes missing.

nodes.label: Inspector template
nodes.rationale: Same template replaces the task dialog's parameter box, so both look the same.

nodes.label: Boundary exception handling
nodes.rationale: except Exception only where FreeCAD or Qt calls in, with noqa reason.

nodes.label: Fully typed
nodes.rationale: mypy disallow_untyped_defs.

nodes.label: Lazy workbench imports
nodes.rationale: So modules import headlessly.

nodes.label: No QtQuick.Controls default
nodes.rationale: Prefer drawn primitives; Basic style fully restyled.

nodes.label: Addon not fork
nodes.rationale: Never require a change to FreeCAD; borrow and put back; leave no trace on uninstall.

nodes.label: graphify knowledge graph rules
nodes.rationale: Query graph before grep to get scoped subgraphs; run graphify update after code changes.

nodes.label: Menu keyed to object
nodes.rationale: FreeCAD's menu follows the workbench and code order; Nxt keys it to the object.

nodes.label: Active container mark
nodes.rationale: Polled every half second; no signal for activation.

nodes.label: Colours from stock tree
nodes.rationale: QApplication.palette ignores stylesheet.

nodes.label: Deferred QSG_RHI_BACKEND
nodes.rationale: Session that never opens the panel is unaffected.

nodes.label: Free sketches and datums groups
nodes.rationale: Panel-only groups avoid restructuring document or adding undo steps.

nodes.label: Nxt's own overlay
nodes.rationale: Panel becomes child of the 3D view GL widget; avoids window manager issues.

nodes.label: Part model history bar
nodes.rationale: Visibility-only rollback, no recompute.

nodes.label: Rename edits Label
nodes.rationale: Name is immutable link identifier.

nodes.label: Searched not filtered
nodes.rationale: Filtering throws away context.

nodes.label: Shelf (replaced)
nodes.rationale: Pulling sketches out lost 'when'; sequence won, reuse moved to annotations.

nodes.label: Timeline paradigm
nodes.rationale: Children in creation order; consumed inputs lifted beside the operation, since ownership claim is false once reused.

nodes.label: wantsPoint hit testing
nodes.rationale: Asked, not inferred: tap handlers don't accept presses.

nodes.label: Priorities performance readability idiom
nodes.rationale: Performance, then readability, then Pythonic idiom; maintainer decides trade-offs.

nodes.label: Qt Quick first
nodes.rationale: New interface is QML; QtWidgets only where FreeCAD requires a widget.

nodes.label: Bandit zero findings
